counterview.reason: Deciding this criterion requires changing the reporter, not just the evaluator, so it belongs to the reader-visible round rather than this one. The reporter renders 风险与限制 from Critic issues (deterministic path, agents/reporter.py) or from model prose (LLM path); neither path can attach a footnote. Measured on the 30 R113 live reports: 0/30 contain a single cited line in 风险与限制, and on the seven counterview questions the section is dominated by statements about missing evidence (证据中缺乏…, 未获取…) rather than a counter-view of the subject. Registering a citation bar now would install a guard that no product change in this round could satisfy, and registering a section-presence bar would reinstate exactly the vacuity R115 removed.
